title: Current Best-Practice Source Research and TMI Standards Register
scope: documentation-only, Tier 2 and Tier 3 research only
guardrailStatement: An external source may inform an internal TMI operating baseline. It does not establish that TMI is certified, compliant, evidence-based, safe, effective, qualified, operational, or authorized, and it does not authorize public claims, service activation, health guidance, legal guidance, commerce, checkout, community operations, or product launch.
researchMethodNote: All sources located via web search against official/primary domains. Direct fetch verification attempted for 2 sources (NIST SP 800-63, W3C WCAG) and blocked by this sandbox's egress policy; dates rely on search-result excerpts from the issuing body's own pages. Re-verify directly before any adoption decision.
excludedResearchTopics: political candidates, elections, litigation, financial-recovery narratives, protected groups, public controversy
therapy, treatment, diagnosis, rehabilitation protocols, tensegrity-based intervention, athlete-health claims

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.tmiOperatingArea: Cross-ecosystem accessibility (all routes, forms, checkout if ever built)
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline for future route, content, form, and checkout accessibility review
sources.doesNotEstablish: that any current TMI route is WCAG-conformant; no conformance claim has been evaluated or made
sources.applicabilityLimits: applies to web content; does not cover in-person event accessibility (see MK16-SRC-13) or product/physical accessibility
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: accessibility specialist review before any conformance-level public statement
sources.revalidationCadence: annual, or upon next WCAG major/minor revision

sources.title: Website Accessibility Conformance Evaluation Methodology (WCAG-EM) 1.0
sources.internalPurpose: internal methodology for HOW to evaluate future route accessibility, distinct from WCAG 2.2's WHAT
sources.doesNotEstablish: conformance itself; it is a procedure for evaluation, not a pass/fail result on its own
sources.applicabilityLimits: informative note, not a normative requirement; dated 2014, predates WCAG 2.2
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: accessibility specialist review before adopting as internal audit procedure

sources.title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
sources.jurisdictionScope: United States, voluntary framework, applicable to organizations of any size
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline taxonomy (Govern/Identify/Protect/Detect/Respond/Recover) for future apps, Workers, forms, and data handling
sources.doesNotEstablish: that TMI currently implements any CSF function; is voluntary and non-certifying
sources.applicabilityLimits: a taxonomy/framework, not a checklist of specific technical controls
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: security specialist review before any internal control is actually implemented

sources.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) 5.0
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline for future app/Worker/API security review (authentication, file handling, error management, cryptography, injection prevention)
sources.doesNotEstablish: that any current TMI Worker/app meets any ASVS level; no product currently exists to evaluate
sources.applicabilityLimits: designed for full applications; only partially applicable to the currently-undeployed contact-intake Worker described in docs/mark-18-contact-intake-implementation.md
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: security specialist review before any control is implemented in a real product
sources.revalidationCadence: annual, or upon next ASVS major revision

sources.title: Protecting Personal Information: A Guide for Business
sources.publicationDate: current, undated point-in-time guidance page (periodically revised by FTC)
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline for data minimization, retention, and access-control review for any future form, account, app, or checkout
sources.doesNotEstablish: legal compliance with any specific US privacy statute; this is general business guidance, not a compliance certification
sources.applicabilityLimits: US-federal-guidance only; does not address state-specific privacy statutes (e.g. CCPA) which would require separate legal review
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: privacy/legal review before any real data collection begins

sources.title: NIST Special Publication 800-63, Digital Identity Guidelines (Revision 4)
sources.publicationDate: Revision 4 in progress/publication per NIST project page as of search date; exact final-publication date not independently verified in this pass (fetch blocked, see researchMethodNote)
sources.jurisdictionScope: United States, federal guidance, broadly referenced by industry
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline for any future account/authentication system
sources.doesNotEstablish: that TMI has any account/authentication system today; no product exists
sources.applicabilityLimits: written primarily for government information systems; private-sector application requires interpretation
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: security/identity specialist review before any account system is designed

sources.title: U.S. Copyright Office fair-use resources (Circular 1: Copyright Basics; Fair Use FAQ; Fair Use Index)
sources.publicationDate: ongoing official government resource, periodically updated
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline for editorial rights-review and attribution process for TMM
sources.doesNotEstablish: that any specific TMI use of third-party material is fair use; fair use is a case-by-case legal determination, not a checklist
sources.applicabilityLimits: US law only; does not address international copyright regimes if content ever crosses borders
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: legal (IP) review before any specific use is finalized

sources.title: PCI DSS v4.0.1
sources.jurisdictionScope: international, applies to any entity that processes/stores/transmits payment card data
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline understanding of payment-data-handling scope boundaries, for the day a checkout is ever considered
sources.doesNotEstablish: that TMI or HERO currently processes payment data through this hub, or that any assessment has occurred; no checkout exists
sources.applicabilityLimits: full standard text is a paid/member resource beyond the public overview; only the publicly available overview was consulted, no substantial copyrighted text was reproduced
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: PCI-qualified security assessor required before any real payment integration
sources.revalidationCadence: not applicable until a checkout is considered

sources.title: FTC Negative Option Rule ("Click-to-Cancel") and related guidance
sources.publicationDate: Final rule announced 2024-10; vacated by a federal appellate court in 2025 for Administrative Procedure Act violations; new FTC rulemaking opened in early 2026 (status unresolved as of this pass)
sources.internalPurpose: internal awareness of disclosure/cancellation-transparency expectations, should TMI or HERO ever offer any recurring/subscription product
sources.doesNotEstablish: a currently binding, stable rule (the 2024 rule was vacated in 2025); does not establish that any TMI or HERO product currently has a subscription mechanism (none exists)
sources.applicabilityLimits: regulatory status is actively in flux; any future reliance requires re-checking current rulemaking status before use
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: legal (consumer-protection) review before any subscription/recurring product is designed
sources.revalidationCadence: re-check at time of any future adoption consideration, given unresolved regulatory status

sources.title: NSCA Codes, Policies, and Procedures (Code of Ethics, scope-of-practice framework)
sources.jurisdictionScope: United States-based professional association, internationally referenced
sources.tmiOperatingArea: Performance — coaching scope-of-practice boundary ONLY, not a training protocol source
sources.internalPurpose: governance/scope-boundary reference only — used to understand what distinguishes general education from supervised coaching, never consulted for or used to produce any training protocol, sprint technique, or therapeutic content
sources.doesNotEstablish: any TMI credential, coaching relationship, or training program; TMI has no verified NSCA-credentialed staff on record in this repository
sources.applicabilityLimits: consulted for governance-boundary purposes only per this pass's explicit restriction against researching or developing training protocols
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: credentialed strength/conditioning professional required before ANY public Performance content, regardless of this source

sources.title: Health Products Compliance Guidance
sources.tmiOperatingArea: Health — restricted domain, claims-substantiation BOUNDARY ONLY
sources.internalPurpose: strengthens the restricted-domain boundary by documenting what level of substantiation the law requires BEFORE any health-adjacent claim — used exclusively to reinforce prohibition, never to inform any actual health/treatment content
sources.doesNotEstablish: any TMI health claim, product, or service; TMI has no health product or service today; this source does not authorize any future one
sources.applicabilityLimits: consulted for governance-boundary purposes only, per this pass's explicit prohibition on researching therapy/treatment/diagnosis content
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: licensed clinical professional AND legal review required before ANY public Health content, regardless of this source
sources.revalidationCadence: annual, or immediately upon any FTC guidance update
sources.ownerDecisionStatus: pending — not applicable until the domain is formally opened by the owner (see docs/internal/mark-15-vertical-standards-evidence-matrix.md item 4)

sources.title: SAA Core Values Statement and Code of Ethics for Archivists
sources.tmiOperatingArea: Reparations — citation/archival-ethics BOUNDARY ONLY, not historical-content research
sources.internalPurpose: governance/citation-methodology boundary reference only — strengthens the restricted-domain requirement that any future historical claim be sourced, reviewed, and correctable; never consulted for or used to produce any actual historical, legal, or political claim
sources.doesNotEstablish: any TMI historical claim, archival holding, or research finding; no research into any specific historical or political subject occurred in this pass
sources.applicabilityLimits: consulted for governance-boundary purposes only, per this pass's explicit prohibition on political/litigation/historical-content research
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: legal review AND a named archival/subject-matter reviewer required before ANY public Reparations content, regardless of this source
sources.revalidationCadence: annual, or immediately upon any new claim under consideration

sources.title: ADA.gov accessibility guidance and U.S. Access Board ADA Accessibility Standards
sources.issuingBody: U.S. Department of Justice (ADA.gov) / U.S. Access Board
sources.jurisdictionScope: United States, federal, applies to places of public accommodation and (per Access Board standards) physical facilities
sources.tmiOperatingArea: Social/Gather — event accessibility boundary; Speaking — venue/accommodation boundary
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline for future in-person event accessibility planning (distinct from web accessibility, MK16-SRC-01/02)
sources.doesNotEstablish: that any TMI event or venue currently exists or has been assessed; Social/Gather has no defined operations today per docs/internal/mark-15-vertical-standards-evidence-matrix.md item 7
sources.applicabilityLimits: US federal law; does not cover event-specific safety/insurance/moderation topics, which require separate review
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: legal/ADA-compliance review before any real event is planned

sources.title: ISO 20700:2017 Guidelines for management consultancy services
sources.internalPurpose: internal baseline for future engagement-scope, responsibility-boundary, and client-communication process design
sources.doesNotEstablish: any TMI Consulting certification or ISO-conformant process; TMI has not been assessed against this standard
sources.applicabilityLimits: full standard text is a paid ISO purchase; only the publicly available scope/summary was consulted, no substantial copyrighted text was reproduced
sources.requiredSpecialistReview: none mandatory at the internal best-practice tier; legal review recommended before any client-facing process language is finalized publicly

validation.sweepResultRule: every occurrence must be internal, conditional, prohibited, source-scoped, owner-review-gated, or explicitly non-assertive

explicitNonActions: no external standard treated as proprietary TMI research
no claim that TMI follows, meets, complies with, implements, certifies against, or is aligned with any standard
no public copy, claims, citations, source links, badges, logos, structured data, or route content created
no vertical, service, app, checkout, form, payment flow, media operation, community, event, health practice, therapy, speaking engagement, or external integration activated
no dependency, package, script, remote asset, or automation added
Cloudflare, DNS, domain, deployment, main branch, PR metadata, and alexandermathai.com untouched
